brief:
Israeli warplanes conducted multiple raids across scattered locations in southern Lebanon, while occupation forces simultaneously detonated explosives in other areas of the region, Shehab Wire reported. The operations represent an escalation in military activity targeting villages and towns across the zone.

The strikes and demolitions underscore the intensifying pattern of Israeli military operations in southern Lebanon. Ground-level explosions accompanied the aerial bombardment as forces continued systematic operations across populated areas, marking a sustained phase of cross-border military engagement in the contested territory along Lebanon's border.
